localFacts.fact: Bundesjagdgesetz § 19 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 verbietet, mit Bolzen oder Pfeilen auf Schalenwild (Reh, Hirsch, Wildschwein), Wölfe und Seehunde zu schießen; die Armbrust ist damit für die Schalenwildjagd in Deutschland kein zulässiges Jagdmittel. The tripod use in Germany is target shooting and sighting in.
Der Deutsche Schützenbund: Armbrüste können ab 18 Jahren erlaubnisfrei erworben werden (keine Waffenbesitzkarte).
The EU Habitats Directive (92/43/EEC) lists crossbows in Annex VI among prohibited means of capture and killing.
In German hunting shops the Primos Trigger Stick Gen. 3 Tall is a 'Zielstock' (Dreibein) with a 61 to 157 cm range.
Foto Erhardt lists the Vanguard Quest T62U at 1020 g, 157,5 cm max. height and 70 cm pack size.

localPainPoints.pain: Holding the weapon for a long wait is tiring; a four-leg or yoke rest does not hold it on its own.
localPainPoints.fix: A clamp tripod (BOG DeathGrip) holds the crossbow hands-free; a yoke (Primos, Vanguard) needs a hand on it.

quotes.text: 2h die Waffe festhalten zu müssen macht keinen Spaß.

localPainPoints.pain: A clamp tripod is slow to set up compared with a shooting stick.
localPainPoints.fix: Clamp tripod for a fixed spot, Primos trigger stick (one-hand height change) when you move.

quotes.text: Das dauert schon ne Minute und geht nicht mal eben schnell wie bei einem Zielstock.

localPainPoints.pain: The carbon DeathGrip is light but bulky to carry.
localPainPoints.fix: Choose the carbon version only for a longer walk to the spot; it saves about 0,5 kg but stays bulky.

quotes.text: Den habe ich aus Carbon. ist leicht, aber sperrig.

localGain.point: States that § 19 BJagdG bans bolts on Schalenwild, so a German reader knows the crossbow tripod is for target shooting and sighting in, not deer hunting.
Crossbows can be bought without a permit from 18 (DSB).
Answers the Wild-und-Hund objections (holding the weapon for hours, slow setup of a clamp tripod) with the matching pick.
Maker/retailer metric figures (Primos 61-157 cm, Vanguard 1020 g / 157,5 cm / 70 cm).
